atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent sprite atlas for Solace, a top-down tile-based village automation game. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: take the middle misty highlands miniature-diorama materials and warm settlement details, not its scenic composition. STRICT atlas: 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 equal rectangular cells, one isolated subject centered in each cell, generous empty transparent gutters, no grid marks, no text. Row1 left-to-right: broadleaf woodland tree with rounded sculpted teal-green canopy and visible trunk; chunky mossy stone outcrop; compact berry bush with distinct red berries; harvestable blue-flowered flax/fiber clump. Row2: golden grain clump; low clay deposit warm terracotta; copper ore rock with distinct copper veins; small timber cottage with thatched roof. Row3: gatherer's hut with open porch and baskets; Hearth composed of a thatched longhouse beside a stone campfire ring (this one will occupy 2x2 game tiles); sturdy stylized human Kith villager carrying a basket overhead, warm clay-orange tunic, moderately enlarged head and hands; horizontal wooden footbridge segment straight left-right. Same overhead orthographic game-sprite camera for ALL assets, camera pitched 65 degrees downward, NORTH up, NEVER isometric diamonds. Each subject full and uncropped, no surrounding terrain bases or scenery. Handcrafted high-quality 3D miniature render feel, tactile thatch and timber, sculpted clustered foliage rather than individual tiny leaves, mossy stone, ambient occlusion, restrained directional daylight from upper-left, soft contact shadow included in alpha, cool misty highland palette contrasted with warm ochre timber and fire. Strong silhouette readable at 48 pixels. Avoid flat vector look, heavy black outlines, photoreal noise, decorative landscape islands, text, logos, overlapping cells. Output 1536x1152 transparent image.
grass: Use case: stylized-concept. Single seamless square TOP-DOWN grass/moss terrain texture for Solace miniature diorama tile-based game. Calm cool misty highland ground, muted sage and moss green. Broad low contrast mottling, very sparse small flattened grass tufts, tiny moss patches. Orthographic directly overhead, no horizon, no perspective, no objects, no trees, no flowers, no rocks, no roads, no vignette, no frame. All four edges must seamlessly tile. Not a scenic background. Material must support dense buildings and resource objects drawn on top at 48px per tile. Tactile softly rendered ground matching a handcrafted miniature 3D game, soft diffuse daylight. Preserve a green surface rather than brown dirt, avoid photographic noise and excessive detail. 1024x1024.
